prompt:
Render a polished mobile Discourse forum for SanForum.at, portrait 390:844 at high resolution, edge to edge with readable German text and no physical device or browser frame. It serves Austria's rescue-service community. Preserve the attached original logo on a contrasting deep-blue header, the #3877E5 light blue accent, white reading surfaces, navy type and one humanist UI sans. This is the approved Fachjournal world: precise title-and-snippet reading rhythm, calm metadata, native buttons, tabs and controls, no decorative cards or marketing hero. Menu, search and account controls remain familiar. Use only illustrative metadata, identified by a small “Beispielansicht”.

Explore a discussion-led overview that still gives category browsing equal prominence. Below the header, use two equally strong destinations “Kategorien” and “Aktuell”. Lead with a compact, clearly titled category finder showing “Informationen”, “Rettungsdienst & Krankentransport”, “Sondereinheiten” and “Sonstiges”, then recent discussions with the native activity filters close to their list. The structural change from a stacked full category directory is a shallow category finder that leaves much more room for readable conversation snippets. Show “Nützliche Apps für den Dienst”, “NFS-Kurs Empfehlung” and “Monitoring im Vergleich”, with category labels, quiet reply counts and time, one “Ungelesen” marker and a visible “Neues Thema” action. Include the beginning of another discussion below. Keep category and discussion access simultaneously evident. No actual post authors, invented service claims, chart tiles, bottom app bar or decorative illustrations.
revisionPrompt: Refine this exact mobile forum screen while retaining its Fachjournal typography, logo, blue header, light body and topic-list design. Make category browsing genuinely compact: replace the four oversized category rows and descriptions with a shallow two-by-two plain text category finder, using the same four parent category names, no illustrations and no invented totals. This finder occupies roughly one sixth of the phone viewport so the current-discussion heading starts near the upper third and the topic list leads the screen. Retain equally prominent Kategorien and Aktuell top destinations. Add a clear small 'Beispielansicht · Beispieldaten' label. Keep standard native forum controls and real German topic titles; correct NFS-Kurs Empfehlung category context to Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung. Do not add anything else or change the portrait frame.
